name: Personal Bank: SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST flags carry the item scaling level for tooltips (#10406)
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling=1 and CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1 with ItemStat.dbc in the data directory.

#10406: SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST (0x03E8 / 1000) carries no item GUID, so the Ascension client (Extensions.dll SetGuildBankItem hook at 0x103b6770 reading GuildBankItem+0x28 and tooltip resolver at 0x103b5d40) reads the item's scaling level from the packet's Flags word (offset 20 for slot 0 when FullUpdate=0), matching the Auction list encoding.

Previously AscensionPersonalBank::SendTabList wrote ITEM_FIELD_FLAGS (0 for an unequipped BoE item, 1 for a soulbound item), causing BoE items in Personal Bank to preview at the viewing character's level and soulbound items to preview at level 1.

With the fix, SendTabList writes LocalLevelScaling::AuctionPreviewLevel when ItemPreviewActive() is true: (1) a BoE Lionfur Armor (17922, authored ItemLevel 10) looted at level 30 with scaling on stores key 33 and sends Flags=33; (2) the same item equipped to become soulbound (ITEM_FIELD_FLAGS=1) and re-deposited still sends Flags=33, not 1; (3) an unscaled 17922 sends its authored ItemLevel 10 so the client shows authored stats instead of scaling to the viewer; (4) non-scalable Linen Cloth (2589) sends Flags=0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI settle
Grant Tattered Cloth Vest (193) to occupy chest slot 4 before looting
Equip Tattered Cloth Vest so auto-equip leaves looted Lionfur Armor unequipped
SETUP: chest slot 4 is occupied by Tattered Cloth Vest (193)
Acquire the Personal Bank
Place the Alliance Personal Bank vault
Let the vault summon land in the world
SETUP: looted Lionfur Armor is BoE (not soulbound, ITEM_FIELD_FLAGS=0)
SETUP: looted Lionfur Armor stores client scaling key 33 at level 30
Open the Personal Bank
Deposit scaled BoE Lionfur Armor into slot 0
The BoE armor left the bags
SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST (1000) slot 0 carries slot index 0
SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST (1000) slot 0 carries Lionfur Armor (17922)
Scaled BoE item sends stored scaling level 33 in SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST Flags (was 0)
Withdraw scaled Lionfur Armor to bind it
Lionfur Armor returned to bags
Equip Lionfur Armor to make it soulbound
Re-equip Tattered Cloth Vest so soulbound Lionfur Armor moves to bags
SETUP: Lionfur Armor is now soulbound (ITEM_FIELD_FLAGS=1)
Re-deposit soulbound scaled Lionfur Armor into slot 0
Soulbound scaled item left the bags
Soulbound scaled item still sends scaling level 33 in SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST Flags (not ITEM_FLAG_SOULBOUND 1)
Withdraw soulbound Lionfur Armor
Destroy scaled Lionfur Armor before testing an unscaled copy
Grant an unscaled Lionfur Armor (17922, authored ItemLevel 10)
Deposit unscaled Lionfur Armor into slot 0
Unscaled Lionfur Armor left the bags
Unscaled scalable item sends its authored ItemLevel 10 in SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST Flags
Withdraw unscaled Lionfur Armor
Grant non-scalable control Linen Cloth (2589)
Deposit Linen Cloth into slot 0
Linen Cloth left the bags
SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST (1000) slot 0 carries Linen Cloth (2589)
CONTROL: non-scalable item sends Flags=0 in SMSG_GUILD_BANK_LIST
